text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while Yamanin Zephyr and I
are walking
along the riverbank, we
come across a few
familiar faces.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that who I think it is?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I don't think it's here. Want to try
looking
closer to the academy?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You may return to the dormitory. I shall
continue
searching here myself.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But... the handkerchief you lost was
given to you
by your grandmother,
right? It must mean a lot to
you, so I
want to help you find it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Greetings. Are the two of you looking
for
something?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah... We're searching for Ruby's

handkerchief. It's red with a rose
embroidered on
it in gold thread. You
haven't seen it, have you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, the wind hasn't blown it
my way.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind is quite strong today, though, so perhaps a mischievous wind has flung it off somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? It appears that any hope of
finding
my handkerchief is quickly
fading. Well, in that
case—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But if the wind was the thief, then we
can simply
follow its trail to find what it
took.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: What? Zephyr! Where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind has led me to... Ah, hello
there, White
Waterinas. Have you seen a
red handkerchief
around?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Is she asking those swans?
Ah, Zephyr!
Please wait a moment!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A Caw-Caw. I see you rode this wind
too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: And now a crow...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the wind rising up to the sky,
but there's
no sign of the handkerchief.
If I follow the faded
breeze the
Caw-Caw rode here on...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It leads to a hive of Buzzy-Wuzzies.

Pardon my intrusion.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Buzzy-Wuzzies"? Those are bees! Quick, get away from the hive!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... After all that walking, we've come full circle back to the academy... But where did Zephyr—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ruby, is that your handkerchief caught
on the
tree over there?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Oh! It would appear so.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: But it's quite high up. At that height...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Z-Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hup... Hup... The breeze that catches
you as you
climb really does feel
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Here you are, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Pfft! Hahaha! You're amazing, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even when we were sure it was a lost
cause, you
pushed on without hesitation
and swept our
worries away as casually
as the wind blows.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even when we were sure it was a lost
cause, you
pushed on without hesitation
and swept our
worries away as casually
as the wind blows.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
While I feel your methods are a little
capricious, I
greatly appreciate your
help. Regarding a reward
for your
efforts—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There's something blowing from the
east... It's
another offbeat breeze.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Zephyr's free spirit is one of her
charms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given how whimsical Yamanin Zephyr
can be, it
gives me peace of mind to
know her friends
understand her.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I simply follow my wind. I go wherever it
takes
me, freely and swiftly.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's a formidable current to be racing
against.
We'll have to make sure we
don't get blown away.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh? ...Is this a pair of whirling vortexes
I'm
sensing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the three of them acknowledging
each other
as rivals, I look forward to
seeing how they'll
motivate each other
moving forward.
